summary_en: 1,242,000 shares cancelled (4.1% of pre-cancellation shares outstanding). Post-cancellation issued shares: 28,854,880. Effective date 2026-05-29.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: Daito Pharmaceutical completed cancellation of 1,242,000 treasury shares on 2026-05-29, representing 4.1% of shares outstanding prior to cancellation. The cancellation was authorized by board resolution on 2026-05-13 and executed under Article 178 of the Companies Act. Following the cancellation, total issued shares amount to 28,854,880, with 16,718 shares remaining in treasury (excluding 94,340 shares held in trust for executive share-grant plans).
